economic_thesis: Perpetual funding is an observable transfer price for directional inventory. A persistent cross-sectional funding extreme marks a crowded side, but crowding alone can persist. Requiring relative price to move against that crowded side identifies an unwind while preserving relative carry: short high-funding relative laggards and long low-funding relative leaders.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The short sleeve targets relatively high-funding assets whose prices have become relative laggards; the balanced long sleeve limits market beta.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The long sleeve targets relatively low-funding assets whose prices have become relative leaders; crowded weak names remain available to the short sleeve.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Balanced sleeves seek cross-sectional funding transfer and crowd unwind rather than market direction; failure to produce positive chop return falsifies the mechanism.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long low-relative-funding contracts only after positive relative-price confirmation.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short high-relative-funding contracts only after negative relative-price confirmation.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Breadth requirements can force flat exposure, while organizer-owned brakes and volatility targeting are evaluated prospectively as separate policies; stress must still satisfy every frozen gate.

falsifier: Reject or pivot if causal stitched OOF evidence fails any development or team-declared A5 score gate in qualification_thresholds.json, if either sleeve is immaterial, if bull/bear/chop net return is nonpositive, if funding-only or price-only ablations match the joint rule, or if the result is an isolated parameter peak. DNF rather than submit a negative or unqualified IS model.
mechanism: At 00:00 UTC, estimate seven-day exponentially decayed funding pressure from strictly past events, cross-sectionally rank it, and combine the opposite-crowding margin with contiguous past-close relative confirmation into one signed score. Pass that exact final dictionary through the A5 identity boundary before filtering. Select both sleeves independently from the returned scores, rank and proportionally allocate by returned magnitude subject to the symbol cap, require breadth on both, and equalize gross exposure without an estimated hedge ratio.
risk_policy_plan: Run the center first with root no-control risk_policy.json and apply every numeric comparison in qualification_thresholds.json#/core_alpha_activation. Volatility-target-only, drawdown-only, position-stop-only, turnover-only, and combined policies remain dormant unless that core passes. Controls cannot rescue failure. Before any later policy commit, registration, and run, copy its immutable risk_policies template byte-for-byte to root risk_policy.json because the frozen lifecycle reads only that path.
selection_metric: Binary eligibility first: every frozen development, A5 score, regime, sleeve, stability, concentration, and doubled-cost gate must pass on stitched chronological evidence. Among passers only, maximize the lower of net Sharpe and doubled-cost Sharpe, then the worst fold/regime Sharpe. A non-passer cannot be selected.
